name: security-review
description: A security review of the person's own code inside their mandate: files ranked by risk, one hunter per file group, every finding proven by a reproducer the harness runs (no reproducer that fires: unconfirmed, for a person), and a report held to the harness's ledger.

focus.description: What to look at first, if anything (a feature, a folder, a kind of flaw)
focus.default: the whole scope of the mandate

hunt.title: Plan and hunt
hunt.prompt: Review the code in the mandate's scope. Focus: {{input.focus}}. Write security/plan.md with every file in scope, then review every file on it and prove each flaw with confirm_finding.

report.title: Report
report.prompt: Write security/findings.md from the findings the harness ran.

check.title: The report holds to the ledger

fix-report.title: Fix the report
fix-report.prompt:
security/findings.md does not hold to the harness's ledger. Fix each problem: call a finding CONFIRMED only when the findings tool says so, and list every confirmed one.

{{feedback}}

failed.title: The report does not hold to the ledger
